topic: Portable Handoff: Keep Context Between AI Chats, Models, and Coding Agents

key_points: Official docs on how Claude Code carries knowledge across sessions via CLAUDE.md (user-written) and auto memory (Claude-written notes)
Every session starts with a fresh context window; CLAUDE.md + auto memory are loaded at session start as context
Memory file hierarchy by scope: org (/etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md) > user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md) > project (./CLAUDE.md) > local (CLAUDE.local.md, gitignored)
CLAUDE.md can import other files with @path syntax (up to 4 hops deep); supports AGENTS.md + Claude-specific instructions
Symlink AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md to keep one source of truth: ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
/compact summarizes conversation when context runs low; /memory audits and edits auto-memory entries
claudeMdExcludes lets you skip other teams' CLAUDE.md files in monorepos
Real-world pain: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, while Cursor and Codex CLI read AGENTS.md — same instruction must live in both, and the copies drift
Three fixes: (1) @ reference a central file, (2) pointer file that says 'READ AGENTS.md FIRST' in ALL CAPS, (3) Unix-style symlink ln -sf AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
Symlinks preserve the exact same content since both names resolve to one inode; @-references and pointers allow Claude-specific additions alongside the shared file
Principle mirrors code DRY: one source of truth routed everywhere
Frames AI agent memory loss as 'amnesia' — agents re-learn context on every interaction unless given persistent memory
Context portability = preferences/context follow you across platforms so you get personalised agents; one of three agentic enabler categories (portability, search APIs, knowledge graphs/ontologies)
Cites Hendrycks et al. (2025) A Definition of AGI: 'Without continual learning, AI systems suffer amnesia, forcing re-learned context each interaction'
Startup ecosystem building context & memory management to treat this
Context portability is the emerging answer to cross-tool, cross-model context carryover
Vendor tool for dynamic AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md context specifically for AI coding agents
Shows category demand: people are building products to keep agent memory files in sync and portable
Claude Code plugin that ports memory/context across tools (works with Gemini CLI and Codex)
Demonstrates the practical cross-model handoff pattern — export your context once, reuse it in another agent

stats.fact: Every Claude Code session begins with a fresh context window; CLAUDE.md and auto memory are the only mechanisms that carry knowledge across sessions by default
Claude Code checks CLAUDE.md files in the current working directory and every directory above it, concatenated into context (closer-to-launch dirs load last)
CLAUDE.md files load at the start of every session and consume tokens alongside the conversation — how concise the instructions are directly affects reliability
Without continual learning, AI agents suffer 'amnesia', forcing them to re-learn context in every interaction, limiting their utility
stats.source: Hendrycks et al. (2025) via MMC research: https://mmc.vc/research/agentic-enablers-treating-ais-amnesia-and-other-disorders/

stats.fact: Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex CLI read different config files by default (CLAUDE.md vs AGENTS.md), causing instructions written to one to be missed by another

AGENTS.md is the cross-tool convention; Claude Code reads AGENTS.md, and its /init can generate a CLAUDE.md incorporating AGENTS.md, Copilot rules (.github/copilot-instructions.md), .devin/rules/, .windsurf/rules/ and .clinerules

angles: Treat agent context like code: one source of truth, exported once, symlinked or imported everywhere — apply DRY to your memory files
The 'amnesia' problem: coding agents re-learn your setup every fresh session; a portable handoff file is your fix
Vendor-agnostic vs lock-in: CLAUDE.local.md for personal prefs, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md for shared team truth, symlinks to avoid drift
Practical copy-paste workflow: write once → symlink/import → keep per-tool specifics minimal
New-model portability: your handoff file follows across Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Codex — not just within one vendor
